elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes an indemnity but no express duty to defend Teleglobe USA Inc. or its affiliates; affiliates are not mentioned.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: Each other Party indemnifies Teleglobe USA Inc. against specified third-party claims, but no indemnity is provided for its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 21.4 covers third-party claims that APCN 2 or supplied equipment, facilities, or software infringes or misappropriates intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: No indemnity for an indemnifying Party's breach of applicable law is included.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No indemnity for a data breach caused by an indemnifying Party is included.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence and wilful misconduct are not covered.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no claim-notice requirement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 21.2 permits an indemnifying Party only to observe and not directly participate, but does not assign control of the defence under the new IP indemnity.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Subparagraph 21.2 retains a broader mutual indemnity concerning APCN 2 claims and does not limit Teleglobe USA Inc.'s indemnity to its content and breach of law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Each other Party must indemnify Teleglobe USA Inc. against third-party claims alleging infringement or misappropriation by APCN 2 or supplied equipment, facilities, or software.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes infringement to the extent arising from a modification made by Teleglobe USA Inc.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes infringement arising from combination with items not supplied by the indemnifying Party.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: The indemnity excludes infringement arising from specifications furnished by Teleglobe USA Inc.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying Party must procure continued-use rights or modify or replace the item so it is non-infringing.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: If none of those remedies is reasonably available, the indemnifying Party must refund amounts paid for the item.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: Aggregate liability under Subparagraph 21.4 is capped at three times the annual O&M Costs payable by Teleglobe USA Inc.
